summary: Specifies a network proxy that uses Multicast DNS to automatically fill the wide-area unicast DNS namespace with records describing devices and services found on the local link. This lets service discovery work beyond a single network segment.

eli5.summary: Your home printer announces itself only to the people in the room. This helper relays that announcement so people elsewhere can find it too.
